title: marked: rename the Renderer listitem hook to listItem
prompt: This is a copy of marked 4.3.0 (src/, ES modules). The Renderer method `listitem` is the only camelCase-violating renderer hook. Rename it to `listItem` everywhere in src: the Renderer definition and every place that calls or references it. Custom renderers registered with `marked.use({ renderer: { listItem() {} } })` must work and the old name must no longer exist anywhere. Rendered output must not change.
